response.overview: The most beautiful student, Snezhana, has been at odds for many years with an equally striking teacher who is always picking on her. During another conflict during an exam, Snezhana, in the heat of the moment, confesses to the teacher that she had an affair with her husband. No one would have wondered whether she was telling the truth if it weren’t for the fatal outcome of the conflict…
response.tagline: When an exam is a reason to die.
response.title: The Fatal Truth
